passive.name: Friend of the Forest
passive.description: Ivern cannot attack or be attacked by non-epic monsters. Ivern can create magical groves on jungle camps which grow over time. When the grove is fully grown, Ivern may free the monsters to receive gold and experience.

spells.name: Rootcaller
spells.description: Ivern conjures a vine, dealing damage and rooting enemy targets hit. Ivern's allies can dash to the rooted target.
spells.tooltip:
Ivern conjures a vine dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Rooting the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} seconds. Allies that Attack a Rooted enemy dash into Attack Range.

Recast: Ivern dashes directly onto the Rooted enemy.

Hitting non-epic monsters reduces Rootcaller's cooldown by 50%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Brushmaker
spells.description: In brush, Ivern and his nearby allies attacks deal bonus magic damage. Ivern can activate this ability to create a patch of brush.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: While in brush and for {{ buffduration }} seconds after leaving, Ivern's Attacks deal an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. Nearby allies will gain this effect for {{ allybuffduration }} seconds and deal {{ totalallydamage }} magic damage.

Active: Ivern grows a patch of Brush, revealing the area for {{ revealduration }} seconds. The Brush persists until Ivern's team loses vision within it, or up to {{ maxbrushduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Triggerseed
spells.description: Ivern places a shield on an ally which explodes after a short duration slowing and damaging enemies. The shield refreshes if it hits no enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Ivern grants {{ totalshield }} Shield to an ally champion or Daisy. After {{ shieldduration }} seconds, it bursts, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing enemies by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

If Triggerseed detonates and no enemy champions are hit while the shield still persists, the ally will be shielded for {{ totalshield }} for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Daisy!
spells.description: Ivern summons his Sentinel friend Daisy to fight with him. Re-cast command Daisy to attack or move.
spells.tooltip:
Ivern summons his sentinel friend Daisy to leap into the fray for {{ daisyduration }} seconds.

Daisy, Slam!: Daisy's 3rd consecutive Attack on the same champion or epic monster will launch a shockwave, dealing {{ totalshockwavedamage }} magic damage to all enemies hit as well as Knocking Up for {{ shockwaveccduration }} second. This effect can only occur once every {{ shockwavecd }} seconds.

Recast: Instruct Daisy to Attack or move.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Friend of the Forest
effects: Innate: Ivern cannot attack nor damage non-epic monsters. Instead, targeting a jungle camp initiates a 2.5 second channel that will plant a grove upon the camp. Placing a grove costs 94.5 : 0.14 (based on level) health and 90 : 0.37 (based on level) mana. The channel cannot be cancelled in the first 0.15 seconds and in the last 0.5 seconds.
Ivern cannot place a grove while he is unable to cast abilities.

The grove matures over 40 : 1 (based on level) seconds. When fully matured, Ivern can target the camp again to free it after a 0.5-second cast time, clearing the camp and receiving the full gold and full experience bounties. Using Smite on a monster within the grove will instantly free the camp regardless of maturity.

If the camp's large monster has already been slain prior to planting a grove, Ivern will free the camp upon completing the channel at no cost. Similarly, the grove will instantly mature if the large monster is slain.

variants.name: Rootcaller
effects: Ivern and allied champions can select the target rooted by Rootcaller to dash to their location, stopping at their attack range.
Recast: Ivern dashes to the rooted target.
Hitting a non-epic monster reduces Rootcaller's cooldown by 50%.

variants.name: Brushmaker
effects: Active: Ivern grows a patch of brush at the target location for 45 seconds, granting sight of the area within and around it for 8 seconds. Brushes despawn instantly after allied vision of them is lost. Spawning brush near terrain or other brush increases its radius.
Ivern periodically stocks a Brushmaker charge, up to a maximum of 3.

variants.name: Triggerseed
effects: If the seed does not damage an enemy champion and the shield persists by the end of the duration, the shield is reapplied for the same strength and duration without the explosion effect.

variants.name: Daisy!
effects: Active: Ivern summons his sentinel friend Daisy to his side, who lands 350 units away from him in the target direction and remains on the field for up to 45 seconds as a controllable pet.
Daisy! can be recast at any time while Daisy is alive.
Recast - Daisy, wait!: Ivern commands Daisy to move to the target location. If cast on Ivern, Daisy will follow him.
The recast of Daisy! can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control. See Pets for more details about Daisy.

changes.title: Base Stats
changes.text: Attack Animations : Restored an alternate attack animation which will be used 25% of the time for regular attacks and every time for critical attacks

changes.title: Base Stats
changes.text: Magic Resistance : 32 (+2.05 per level) ⇒ 30 (+1.3 per level) (Note: this is typical for other ranged champions)

changes.title: W - Brushmaker
changes.text: Ally On-Hit Damage : 5/7.5/10/12.5/15 (+10% of Ivern's AP) ⇒ 10/15/20/25/30 (+10% of Ivern's AP)

changes.title: E - Triggerseed
changes.text: Shield Strength : 80/115/150/185/220 (+75% AP) ⇒ 85/125/165/205/245 (+50% AP) (Note: this will be a buff until Ivern’s gets 20/40/60/80/100 AP)

changes.title: R - Daisy!
changes.text: Health : 1300/2600/3900 (+50% AP) ⇒ 1000-4400 (levels 6-18, nonlinear scaling) (+50% AP) (Note: this is approximately a 5% durability decrease)

changes.title: R - Daisy!
changes.text: Daisy! Attack Damage : 70/100/130 (+30% AP) ⇒ 70/100/130 (+15% AP) (Note: final shockwave damage is unchanged)

changes.title: Q - Rootcaller
changes.text: Jump for Joy! : Ivern can now recast Q to jump directly to the target, while Ivern and allies can issue an attack command to move to their auto attack range’s distance away from the target.

changes.title: Q - Rootcaller
changes.text: Non-Epic Change : Q’s cooldown is now reduced by 50% when used on non-Epic monsters.

changes.title: W - Brushmaker
changes.text: Redefining Death Bush : Brushmaker’s Passive bonus magic damage on-hit when exiting the brush for 3 seconds now applies to ally champions.

changes.title: W - Brushmaker
changes.text: Brush Spawn Vision Duration : 3 seconds ⇒ 8 seconds

changes.title: W - Brushmaker
changes.text: Brush Duration : 30 seconds ⇒ Up to a maximum of 45 seconds or until your team loses vision inside of them

changes.title: W - Brushmaker
changes.text: Lookie! : Auto attacks empowered with Brushmaker now have a special visual effect to reflect the on-hit damage (note: this change is visual only).

changes.title: E - Triggerseed
changes.text: Change : If, when the shield detonates, there are no enemies that are hit by the detonation and the shield has not been broken, the duration of the shield is renewed.

changes.title: R - Daisy

changes.title: R - Daisy

changes.title: R - Daisy!

changes.title: Q - Rootcaller

changes.title: Q - Rootcaller
changes.text: ABRA-KADABRA-ALAKAZAM: Fixed a bug where allies would teleport to unexpected locations when Ivern would dash to a rooted target
